text:
Stilgherrian

Word-whore. I write 'em. I talk 'em. Information, politics, media, and the cybers. I drink. I use bad words. All publication is a political act. All communication is propaganda. All art is pornography. All business is personal. All hail Eris! Vive les poissons rouges sauvages!

I’m extracting an entire household’s worth of stuff from storage, where it’s been for 15 years. It’s a combination of a time capsule and a garage sale! Here’s how you can get your hands on it all.

If you’d like more background information, do check out my GoFundMe campaign The 9pm Stilgherrian’s Dramatic Decamp to Campsie, or watch the YouTube livestreams.

The quickest way is to email me an offer for anything that catches your eye. Or tell me what you’re interested in and I’ll suggest a price. Either way, I’ll mark the items as RESERVED and we’ll take it from there. You have until Sunday 2 August to do that.

After that I’ll be posting some of the better items on Gumtree or wherever, and the rest will be offered in bulk to appropriate resellers. And what isn’t of interest after that will go into the recycling skip.

Items can be collected from Campsie in Sydney, or I can post them anywhere in Australia.

Last updated 3 August 2026.
